message.content: {"mechanism_id":"F-memory-viability-gated-update","target_component":"F memory update (M_F Lehmer mean) in L-SHADE","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-03","trace_path":"none_provided","function":"F4,F11,F15","seed":0,"metric":"F_mean trajectory","observed_value":0.08},"causal_hypothesis":"Successful trials with tiny F produce small delta_f, so Lehmer mean overweights them and drives M_F toward 0; once F is near zero, differential vectors vanish and progress stalls, but selection still accepts marginal improvements that reinforce low F.","algorithmic_change":"Gate each successful trial's contribution to the F-memory Lehmer mean by a viability weight that decays when the trial's realized F is below a viability threshold, so low-F successes cannot dominate the memory update.","mathematical_rule":"w_i = |delta_f_i| * g(F_i), where g(F) = 1 if F >= F_viab else (F / F_viab)^2; F_viab = 0.2. M_F = sum(w_i * F_i^2) / sum(w_i * F_i) (weighted Lehmer).","expected_effect":"Prevents M_F collapse below ~0.2 while still allowing occasional low-F exploration; keeps differential vectors non-vanishing and sustains convergence on F4/F11/F15.","failure_prediction":"On unimodal/separable functions where low F is genuinely optimal, gating may slow late-stage fine-tuning and slightly increase final error; if F_viab too high, exploration is over-forced and convergence rate drops.","ablation_plan":"Compare (a) baseline Lehmer, (b) viability-gated Lehmer with F_viab in {0.1,0.2,0.3}, (c) hard F floor 0.2, across F4/F11/F15 and 5 seeds; measure F_mean trajectory, final error, and success rate.","nearest_known_methods":"Weighted Lehmer mean memory (SHADE/L-SHADE), F-floor clamping, success-history adaptation, jSO-style F bounds.","implementation_requirements":"Track per-success realized F_i and delta_f_i; add g(F) weighting in the M_F Lehmer update; expose F_viab as a parameter; no change to mutation or selection."}
